Returns the angle whose cosine is the given number. The result is in degrees, from 0 to 180. A number outside -1 to 1 has no such angle.

```blitzbasic
;run
Print ACos(0.5)
```

```text
60.0
```
@param float  The cosine, from -1 to 1.
@returns The angle in degrees.
